style: Flat 2D vector explainer style, minimalist hand-drawn: thick, slightly imperfect black outlines, uniform weight; solid-color fills only, no shading, gradients or textures. Clean, warm, playful educational tone. Humans: perfect white circle heads, two dot eyes, no nose, curved-line mouth, thin single-stroke stick limbs, rounded sock-shaped hands and feet, loose brown scribble hair; emotion only via mouth and eyebrow angles, floating sweat drops, question marks or motion lines. Modern people wear plain clothing. Animals are never stick figures: proportional, semi-realistic flat-cartoon anatomy with full body volume, bent joints, curved spine, small heads, accurate ears, tails, hooves and paws; running adds curved speed streaks and foot-level dust puffs. Scenes wide and mostly empty: flat ground and sky divided by a thin horizon, sparse scribble grass, rounded bushes; props as simple flat silhouettes. Infographics: white background, pictograms, arrows, dotted lines, checks and crosses, matching line weight. Settings: DAY pale blue sky, sandy tan ground; DUSK pale blue sky with dusty pink horizon band, warm tan ground; LAB clinical off-white/grey walls, grey tile floor, simple tables and shelving, even overhead light. Recurring characters must match their reference images exactly. No readable words, letters, numbers or signage anywhere; communicate only through pictograms, arrows, quantity, grouping and visual metaphor.

refPrompts.CH_CROW: The story's recurring crow: a proportional bird with full body volume, curved back, rounded chest, slim dark legs, straight medium black beak, solid black feather fill with a slightly ragged throat, one small round alert eye with a tiny white highlight dot; side view standing, head high, clever and watchful. Same individual reappears perched, in flight and handling tools.
refPrompts.CH_OCTOPUS: The story's recurring octopus: large rounded mantle head, one big eye with a horizontal bar-shaped pupil, eight long muscular arms with tapered curling tips and a row of small suction dots underneath, smooth solid red-brown body fill; able to compress its body thin; side view drifting with two arms curled forward.
refPrompts.CH_ELEPHANT: The story's recurring adult female elephant, the matriarch: solid grey-blue fill, large fan-shaped ears, short white curved tusks, long trunk with a gentle S curve, small calm eye with lid line, columnar legs with rounded toenails, slightly larger than her herd-mates; side view, trunk relaxed.
refPrompts.CH_PIG: The story's recurring domestic pig: plump rounded pink body, upturned disc snout with two nostril dots, small folded ears, thin curled tail, short legs with simple rounded trotters, bright clever dot eyes; side view, standing square, alert and friendly.

images.prompt: A single modern human stands small on open sandy ground just left of centre, head tilted slightly up, mouth a confident small curve; above the head a large thought bubble holding one brain pictogram with short ray strokes around it. One grass tuft at the left edge, thin low horizon, generous empty sky. DAY setting, even daylight from upper left; head and bubble on the centre line for the slow push-in.

A scientist in a plain lab coat stands at the right, binoculars raised toward a small crow perched on a rounded bush at the left; on the ground between them lies a large stone tablet carved with a brain pictogram, split by a jagged crack with two corner fragments tipped away; the scientist leans toward the bird with curious raised eyebrows. Sparse grass, low horizon. DAY setting, even daylight from upper right; composed tight on the cracked tablet so the pull-out widens to the watching scene.

A scientist centred facing forward on open ground, both hands lifted to chest height with palms up, mouth a small open circle, eyebrows raised; three question-mark squiggles of different sizes float around the head. At the far left and right edges four vague grey animal silhouettes face inward: a small bird, a tentacled rounded shape, a large heavy shape, a round pig shape. DAY setting, even daylight; question marks on the centre line for the push-in.

Four animals gathered in one open grassy scene around a small round pond: a crow perched on a rock at the left holding a bent twig in its beak, an octopus resting in the pond with two arms raised over the rim, a tall elephant at centre right, and a pig standing at the right; all calm, facing slightly toward the viewer. Sparse scribble grass, one rounded bush, low hills far back, thin horizon, empty sky above. DAY setting, even daylight from upper left; the group held in the middle band so the pull-out widens over all four.

Tall composition built low to high: sandy ground with a few grass tufts at the bottom, one bare tree trunk rising through the middle, and the crow perched on a high bare branch at the top of frame in profile, head angled down, tail feathers visible; one rounded bush at the trunk base. DAY setting, even daylight from the left; the tilt-up climbs the trunk and lands on the crow.

Two-panel process on a white background, panels side by side divided by a thin vertical rule, the crow drawn the same size in both: left, the crow gripping one end of a straight wire in its beak with the free end curling upward, two short curved motion arcs at the beak; right, the same crow pulling upward on the wire now bent into a full hook, the hook looped around a food morsel lifted clear of a narrow tube, two small upward motion lines beside the morsel. A human standing at the right with arms half-raised, slanted annoyed eyebrows and a small open mouth; three crows around them: two on the ground at the lower left with beaks wide open and short scold dashes aimed at the human, and a third crow perched just behind the pair with its beak open toward the two callers and tiny dash marks between beaks, passing the warning on.
